## Analysis

Scanning inter‑residue heavy‑atom contacts, most of the structure (helix‑internal i/i+3, i/i+4 packing, the hairpin turn, the inter‑helix interface near residues 23/63–67 and 20/70) shows only normal contacts (closest approaches ≥ 2.8–3.5 Å, giving ≤ 0.1 Å overlap).

One contact stands far out:

- **GLN B56 NE2** (−11.699, −8.770, −1.269)
- **ASP B60 OD2** (−10.280, −7.778, −1.311)

Δ = (−1.419, −0.992, 0.042) → **d = 1.73 Å**

With Bondi radii (N 1.55, O 1.52):
overlap = 1.55 + 1.52 − 0.40 − 1.73 = **+0.94 Å**

Supporting contacts in the same pair (GLN56 CD···OD2 = 2.93 Å, overlap −0.11; ASP60 CG···NE2 = 2.82 Å, overlap +0.03) confirm the side‑chain amide of Gln56 is driven into the Asp60 carboxylate. No other residue pair anywhere in the model approaches this severity (next worst overlaps are only ~0.05–0.1 Å from routine backbone geometry).

FINAL: B:Q56--B:D60
